samples.reply: Third time for this one today — same answer: the standing calf stretch. Stand facing a wall, step one foot back and keep that leg straight with the heel on the ground, then lean forward into the wall until you feel a gentle pull in the back of your calf. Hold for 20–30 seconds per side. It's easy to do right after a walk and helps loosen up calves that tighten from repetitive walking.
